summary: Master ALMP and social protection design. Learn ILO & OECD frameworks to build resilient labor markets and safety nets. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Training in active labor market policies and social protection explains how employment support and income safety nets can be connected. It is for professionals who design, deliver or evaluate labor and social welfare initiatives, with practical work in labor-market diagnostics, targeted employment and vocational training interventions, and social protection design, including digital registries and monitoring and evaluation frameworks.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and evaluation of labor and social welfare initiatives.
modules: Labor Market Diagnostics and Data Analytics
Designing Effective Active Labor Market Policies
Social Protection Systems and Safety Net Design
Digital Transformation and Social Registry Management
Financing and Governance of Social Programs
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of public policy or economics. At least three years of experience in labor, social welfare, or economic development is recommended. No programming skills are required, but familiarity with basic data analysis in Excel is beneficial for the exercises.
